fullPassage: There once lived a man in a village who was not happy with his life. He was always troubled by one problem or another. One day, a saint with his guards stopped by his village. Many people heard the news and started going to him with their problems. The man also decided to visit the saint. Even after reaching the saint's place in the morning, he didn't get the opportunity to meet him till evening. When the man got to meet the saint, he confessed that he was very unhappy with life because problems always surrounded him, like workplace tension or worries about his health. He said, "Please give me a solution so that all the problems in my life will end and I can live peacefully." The saint smiled and said that he would answer the request the next day. But the saint also asked if the man could do a small job for him. He told the man to take care of a hundred camels in his group that night, saying "When all hundred camels sit down, you can go to sleep." The man agreed. The next morning when the saint met that man, he asked if the man had slept well. Tired and sad, the man replied that he couldn't sleep even for a moment. In fact, the man tried very hard but couldn't make all the camels sit at the same time because every time he made one camel sit, another would stand up. The saint told him, "You realized that no matter how hard you try, you can't make all the camels sit down. If one problem is solved, for some reason, another will arise like the camels did. So, humans should enjoy life despite these problems."

questions.passage: There once lived a man in a village who was not happy with his life. He was always troubled by one problem or another. One day, a saint with his guards stopped by his village. Many people heard the news and started going to him with their problems. The man also decided to visit the saint. Even after reaching the saint's place in the morning, he didn't get the opportunity to meet him till evening. When the man got to meet the saint, he confessed that he was very <u>unhappy</u> with life because problems always surrounded him, like workplace tension or worries about his health. He said, "Please give me a solution so that all the problems in my life will end and I can live peacefully." The saint smiled and said that he would answer the request the next day. But the saint also asked if the man could do a small job for him. He told the man to take care of a hundred camels in his group that night, saying "When all hundred camels sit down, you can go to sleep." The man agreed. The next morning when the saint met that man, he asked if the man had slept well. Tired and sad, the man replied that he couldn't sleep even for a moment. In fact, the man tried very hard but couldn't make all the camels sit at the same time because every time he made one camel sit, another would stand up. The saint told him, "You realized that no matter how hard you try, you can't make all the camels sit down. If one problem is solved, for some reason, another will arise like the camels did. So, humans should enjoy life despite these problems."

det.korean: unhappy(불행한)의 반의어는 content(만족한)이다.
det.analysis:
✅ ① content(만족한): unhappy의 반의어 ←정답
❌ ② miserable(비참한): unhappy와 유사 방향
❌ ③ anxious(불안한): 부정 감정으로 유사 방향
❌ ④ curious(궁금한): 의미축이 다름

questions.stem: 다음 (A)와 (B)의 밑줄 친 stand의 의미로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.korean: (A) stand up = (몸을) 일으키다/서다, (B) cannot stand = 참다/견디다
det.analysis:
✅ ③ (A) 서다/일어서다 — (B) 참다/견디다: 각 문맥에 맞는 의미 ←정답
❌ ① (A) 참다 — (B) 참다: (A) 맥락에 부적합
❌ ② (A) 서다 — (B) 서다: (B) 맥락에 부적합
❌ ④ (A) 참다 — (B) 서다: 두 문맥 모두 반대
det.tip: stand up(일어서다) vs. cannot stand(참을 수 없다)

questions.stem:
다음 영영 정의에 해당하는 단어로 가장 적절한 것은?

"a means of solving a problem or dealing with a difficult situation"

det.korean: 문제를 풀거나 어려운 상황을 다루는 방법 = solution(해결책)
det.analysis:
✅ ④ solution(해결책): 원문 'give me a solution' — 문제 해결 방법 ←정답
❌ ① problem(문제): 해결 대상이지 방법이 아님
❌ ② question(질문): 정의와 맞지 않음
❌ ③ mistake(실수): 정의와 맞지 않음
det.tip: solution = 해결책. a means of solving a problem = 문제를 푸는 방법
